title: The employer in the fund menu
hook: Two stated cases: explore the exposure induced by an allocation menu.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the exposure induced by an allocation menu affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines StockMoney, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the exposure induced by an allocation menu in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
